title: Suzlon Energy Ltd — Shareholders meeting
text: Suzlon Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Annual General Meeting held on September 11, 2026. Further, the company has submitted the Exchange a copy of Srutinizers report along with voting results.
